mcqs.question: The field of discourse analysis emerged in ______.

Which one is a type of communicative event in which speech is the main component?
In speech events, there is enormous ______ in what people say in different circumstances.
What are discourse markers used for?
Discourse markers are used ______.
options: to mark a boundary in discourse

According to H. Paul Grice (1975), the purpose of the cooperative principle is to make communication ______.

The study of language and political economy emerged during the ______ from parallel currents in several fields.
Speech community is a term in ______ used to describe a group of people who share the same language.

Which of the following is a traditional topic in sociology?
